facts: The instantaneous rate of change at $x = c$ is $f'(c)$, the gradient of the tangent line at $x = c$.
Read the two points off the **tangent line**, not off the curve.
When the axes represent physical quantities, state the rate with compound units, such as $\text{m/s}$, $^{\circ}\text{C/min}$ or $\text{L/s}$.
Hand-drawn tangents vary slightly, so a graph estimate is only close to the true gradient.
steps: Locate the specified point $P(c, f(c))$ on the curve. Use the supplied tangent, or draw a straight line with the same direction as the curve at $P$.
Select two suitably spaced points $(x_1, y_1)$ and $(x_2, y_2)$ on the tangent whose coordinates can be read or estimated; they need not both be exact grid intersections.
State the estimated instantaneous rate of change, including appropriate units when the axes represent physical quantities.

foundation.solution_text:
Choose two points on the tangent line: $(0, 0)$ and $(4, 8)$.
$f'(2) = \dfrac{8 - 0}{4 - 0}$
$= \dfrac{8}{4}$
$= 2$

Read two points on the tangent line: $(0, 70)$ and $(30, 10)$.
$T'(10) = \dfrac{10 - 70}{30 - 0}$
$= \dfrac{-60}{30}$
$= -2^{\circ}\text{C/min}$

Read two points on the tangent: $(0,1)$ and $(4,5)$.
$f'(2)\approx\dfrac{5-1}{4-0}=\dfrac{4}{4}=1$

Using points $(0, -1)$ and $(2, 3)$ on the tangent line:
$f'(1) = \dfrac{3 - (-1)}{2 - 0}$
$= \dfrac{4}{2}$
$= 2$

Use the points $(2, 10)$ and $(6, 50)$ on the tangent line:
$\text{Instantaneous speed} = \dfrac{50 - 10}{6 - 2}$
$= \dfrac{40}{4}$
$= 10\text{ m/s}$

Read two points on the tangent: $(0,4)$ and $(4,0)$.
$f'(2)\approx\dfrac{0-4}{4-0}=\dfrac{-4}{4}=-1$

development.solution_text:
Using the tangent points $(0, 15)$ and $(40, 75)$:
$\text{Rate} = \dfrac{75 - 15}{40 - 0}$
$= \dfrac{60}{40}$
$= 1.5\text{ mL/s}$

Using points $(0, 9)$ and $(4, 1)$ on the tangent line:
$g'(2) = \dfrac{1 - 9}{4 - 0}$
$= \dfrac{-8}{4}$
$= -2$

Read two points on the tangent: $(1,180)$ and $(6,480)$.
$\text{Growth rate}\approx\dfrac{480-180}{6-1}=\dfrac{300}{5}=60\text{ individuals/year}$

mastery.solution_text:
Read two points on the tangent: $(4,30)$ and $(16,78)$.
$T'(10)\approx\dfrac{78-30}{16-4}=\dfrac{48}{12}=4^{\circ}\text{C/min}$

Read two points on the tangent: $(-2,3)$ and $(1,-0.5)$.
$f'(1)\approx\dfrac{-0.5-3}{1-(-2)}=\dfrac{-3.5}{3}\approx-1.17$

Read two points on the tangent: $(1,2)$ and $(7,14)$.
$f'(4)\approx\dfrac{14-2}{7-1}=\dfrac{12}{6}=2$
